record.notes: Initial public draft dated January 2026; NIST invited public comments until 31 March 2026. NIST's guidelines page, updated 30 September 2026, still lists only the initial public draft, now under the Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence (CAISSI), the name NIST uses for CAISI after EO 14434 (US-26). The draft answers the AI Action Plan's call (US-16) for CAISI to publish guidelines and resources for federal agencies' evaluations of AI systems, and refers to NIST AI 100-1 (US-02) and NIST AI 800-1 (US-07) for organisational evaluation practices.

verification.note: Recheck of 17 Oct 2026: re-read the nvlpubs.nist.gov PDF and the NIST guidelines page stored on 11 Oct 2026 (the archiver found both unchanged on 17 Oct 2026). The PDF confirms the title, NIST AI 800-2 ipd, the DOI, January 2026, CAISI authorship and draft status; the guidelines page (updated 30 Sep 2026) still lists only the initial public draft and gives the 31 Mar 2026 comment deadline. The earlier notes' description of the draft as CAISI's 'main published guideline after the 2025 reorganisation' was replaced with what the page shows.
